title: GitHub Pull Request Review
prompt: Review the selected pull request and its changed-file patches. Summarize behavior changes, test evidence, and concrete review risks tied to file paths; do not merge or comment.
instructions: Read the pull request by repository and pull number, then retrieve its changed-file list and patches through the read-only GitHub pull-files endpoint. Do not rely on issue search alone. Review only the returned files and patch context, state when patch text is missing or truncated, and do not claim a full codebase review. Do not create reviews, comments, commits, or merge the PR.
fixture_summary: Synthetic pull request #42 changes two files: an input validator and a retry loop. The fixture PR details describe the intent; the files endpoint provides bounded patches with one missing null-case test.

records.title: Validate request IDs before retry
records.detail: Synthetic PR #42: validates request IDs before retries and adds bounded backoff. Two files changed; automated checks report 8 passing tests.

records.title: src/validate-request.ts
records.detail: Synthetic patch: rejects empty request IDs and normalizes whitespace. Patch does not show a null-input assertion in the test file.

records.title: src/retry.ts
records.detail: Synthetic patch: caps attempts at three and adds exponential delay. Retry cancellation behavior is unchanged in the shown hunk.
